title: Trigger Miss Entry
description: A logged instance where no trigger table entry matched the task input. Used to build training data for LLM fallback classifier (v2.2 P6).

input_text.description: The task description or user request that didn't match any trigger

attempted_match.description: What the agent tried to match against (e.g., 'trigger table', 'flow routing')

fallback_action.description: What happened instead of a trigger match

correct_skill.description: The skill that should have matched (filled in retroactively by operator). Null until classified.

session_id.description: Session ID where the miss occurred
